verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly advertises automatic, no-redemption cashback ('Earn unlimited cashback automatically deposited into your account — no manual redemption or confusing points') and quantifies it as 1.5% cashback on credit card spend integrated with card controls. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user corroboration specifically of the cashback mechanic (community evidence covers cards/limits but not cashback crediting) and detail on eligibility/tiering.
